en.expert: The session cap and saved preference are reported to contaminate each other in opposite directions. Reload can lift a tighter session constraint, while saving a preference can persist the temporary cap.
en.kitchen: A reported rehearsal lowers the allowance for one service, then restores a higher one when the house rulebook is opened. Saving an unrelated preference can also turn that temporary ceiling into a lasting house rule.
